note: Independent re-quantisation of the pinned bf16 head (EigenLabs/Qwen3.8-27B-MTP-bf16) to 4-bit affine group-64 with MLX 0.32.0 mx.quantize(group_size=64, bits=4), matching the backbone geometry so the scales-keyed loader walk needs no code change. The 8 2D Linear weights become packed U32 weights plus bf16 scales/biases (31 tensors); the 7 1D norms stay bf16. The head only proposes; the pinned target re-verifies every emitted token against the hidden serial trajectory. sha256 is the tree digest over the single fetched model.safetensors per the documented rule; bytes is the fetched file size. Local paired measurement on the frontier tree (128-token window): 4-bit head MTP 0.01505 s/token vs bf16 0.01572 (4.5% faster), speedup 2.42 vs 2.30, at a 3.5pp acceptance cost (0.956 vs 0.991) that the frontier's h=0.18 schedule already prices.
